title: TR-MT263-DepsAndIpcPurge
group: TR Legacy TS notes editor removal
clause: Purge notes-only dependencies (@tiptap/* x9 + yjs) and dead notes-only api.ts client functions after import-graph verification; monaco-editor and shared/native-consumed backend routes STAY; regenerate lockfile + third-party notices + dependency-policy allowlist; capture bundle-size before/after evidence. Hard-depends on MT-262.

scope.summary:
GOAL: After MT-262 deletes the legacy TS notes-editor source, remove the now-dead notes-only dependencies and dead notes-only frontend IPC/API client surface — precisely, without touching anything still consumed by surviving code surfaces or by the native editors. This shrinks the bundle and makes it impossible to re-introduce the tiptap editor by import. Nothing is removed until an import-graph scan proves it has zero surviving consumers.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) app/package.json — remove the 9 notes-only @tiptap/* dependencies and yjs; (b) app/package-lock.json — regenerated by a clean install; (c) app/src/lib/api.ts — remove the notes-only client functions whose only callers were the deleted React notes editor (verified dead); (d) app/src/lib/dependency_policy/runtime_dependency_allowlist.json and any allowlist/notice tests — drop the removed packages so the dependency-policy gate stays green; (e) regenerated third-party notices (npm run generate:third-party-notices); (f) a recorded bundle-size before/after measurement under the external artifacts root. NO monaco change, NO backend route change, NO src-tauri command removed unless proven dead.

DETAILED SPEC:
1) DEPENDENCY REMOVAL (app/package.json dependencies) — REMOVE these notes-only packages (REAL current versions): @tiptap/core ^3.13.0, @tiptap/extension-collaboration ^3.13.0, @tiptap/extension-list ^3.13.0, @tiptap/extension-mention ^3.13.0, @tiptap/extension-table ^3.13.0, @tiptap/pm ^3.13.0, @tiptap/react ^3.13.0, @tiptap/starter-kit ^3.13.0, @tiptap/suggestion ^3.13.0, and yjs ^13.6.27 (its only consumers were the tiptap collaboration extension set + RichTextEditor/RichDocumentView/build_editor_extensions, all deleted in MT-262). KEEP (do NOT remove): monaco-editor ^0.55.1 (shared — app/src/lib/monaco/* powers CodeSymbolPanel/SourceControlPanel/code_intelligence/breakpoint_gutter/language_registry code surfaces), @excalidraw/excalidraw, @xterm/* (4), react, react-dom, @tauri-apps/api + plugins. VERIFY BEFORE REMOVAL: `grep -rn '@tiptap' app/src` and `grep -rn "from 'yjs'\|from \"yjs\"\|require('yjs')" app/src` must return ZERO non-allowlist hits after MT-262; if any surviving file imports them, STOP and report (MT-262 is incomplete). monaco import graph must remain intact (`grep -rn 'monaco-editor' app/src/lib/monaco` still non-zero).
2) FRONTEND IPC / API CLIENT PURGE — FINDING: the legacy notes editor persisted over HTTP through app/src/lib/api.ts (request('/knowledge/documents...')), NOT through Tauri invoke; app/src/lib/ipc/* contains NO notes-document commands. Therefore: (i) In app/src/lib/api.ts remove ONLY the notes-document client functions whose sole callers were the deleted editor (e.g. createDocument and the /knowledge/documents draft/save/blocks/history/projection/embeds/backlinks client wrappers) AFTER a grep proves no surviving app/src file calls them; if the native shell or any surviving panel still calls a given function, KEEP it. (ii) TAURI COMMANDS: scan src-tauri (and app/src/lib/ipc/*) for any invoke command that was called ONLY by the deleted notes editor; the expected result is NONE (notes used HTTP). Remove a Tauri command + its backend route ONLY when a usage scan proves it is unused by BOTH surviving app/src AND the native frontend/backend. (iii) BACKEND KNOWLEDGE ROUTES STAY: the handshake_core /workspaces/{id}/knowledge/documents and /loom/* routes are consumed by the native editors (WP-KERNEL-012 MT-044 binds_backend_api) — they are NOT dead and MUST NOT be removed here.
3) LOCKFILE + POLICY REGEN: run a clean dependency install to regenerate app/package-lock.json; update app/src/lib/dependency_policy/runtime_dependency_allowlist.json to drop the removed packages; run `npm run generate:third-party-notices` and `npm run check:third-party-notices`; run `npm run check:dependency-policy`. Update the dependency-policy vitest fixtures/tests (allowlist.test.ts, bundled_library_policy.test.ts, third_party_notices.test.ts, package_lock_audit.test.ts) that assert on the removed packages.
4) BUNDLE-SIZE EVIDENCE: run `npm run build` before-and-after within this MT (or diff against a recorded pre-removal baseline) and record the vite dist bundle size delta (total + per-chunk for the editor chunk) into ${HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT:-../Handshake_Artifacts}/wp-kernel-017/tr-deps-purge/bundle_size_delta.json. Removing tiptap+yjs must show a measurable reduction; a non-reduction is a red flag that a dep was not actually tree-shaken out.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Confirm MT-262 completed: `grep -rn '@tiptap' app/src` and the yjs grep return zero non-allowlist source hits; if not, STOP.
2. Record the pre-removal bundle baseline: `cd app && npm run build` then capture dist size.
3. Remove the 10 notes-only deps from app/package.json; run a clean install to regenerate package-lock.json.
4. api.ts purge: for each candidate notes-only client function, grep app/src for callers; remove only the proven-dead ones; keep any with a surviving caller.
5. Tauri/backend scan: prove no notes-only-invoked command remains; remove only proven-dead commands+routes (expected: none); leave shared/native-consumed routes intact.
6. Update runtime_dependency_allowlist.json + the four dependency_policy tests; run check:dependency-policy, generate+check:third-party-notices.
7. Rebuild: `cd app && npm run build`; capture post-removal dist size; write bundle_size_delta.json to the external artifacts root.
8. `cd app && npm test` and `npm run lint` green. Record measured output. Repo-wide reference sweep + CI re-introduction guard + manuals + final visual smoke are MT-264.
allowed_paths: app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (or the generator's output path; regenerated via npm run generate:third-party-notices)
src-tauri/** (ONLY a Tauri command proven dead — unused by surviving app/src AND native; expected: no change)
forbidden_paths: app/src/lib/editor/**, app/src/lib/tiptap/**, app/src/components/**, app/src/harness/** (already removed in MT-262; not re-touched here)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/api/knowledge_documents.rs, src/backend/handshake_core/src/api/loom.rs (routes consumed by the native editors; MUST NOT be removed)
acceptance_criteria: app/package.json no longer lists @tiptap/core, @tiptap/extension-collaboration, @tiptap/extension-list, @tiptap/extension-mention, @tiptap/extension-table, @tiptap/pm, @tiptap/react, @tiptap/starter-kit, @tiptap/suggestion, or yjs.
app/package.json STILL lists monaco-editor (and @excalidraw/excalidraw, @xterm/*, react, react-dom, @tauri-apps/*).
`grep -rn '@tiptap' app/src` and the yjs source grep return zero hits outside the dependency-policy allowlist/notice artifacts; the removal was verified against the import graph, not assumed.
app/package-lock.json is regenerated by a clean install and contains no @tiptap/* or yjs entries.
Only notes-only api.ts client functions with zero surviving callers are removed; any function still called by a surviving surface is kept (verified by grep).
No Tauri command or backend route consumed by a surviving app/src surface OR by the native editors is removed; the handshake_core /knowledge/documents and /loom/* routes are untouched.

runtime_dependency_allowlist.json and the four dependency_policy tests are updated so `npm run check:dependency-policy` and `npm run check:third-party-notices` pass; third-party notices are regenerated.
A bundle_size_delta.json recorded under the external artifacts root shows a measurable dist size reduction after removing tiptap+yjs.
`cd app && npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run lint` are green after the purge.
No app/src/lib/monaco/ file and no backend knowledge/loom route file is modified.
proof_targets: bash -lc "grep -rn '@tiptap' app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v dependency_policy | wc -l | grep -q '^0$' && echo NO_TIPTAP_SOURCE_IMPORTS"
cd app && npm run check:dependency-policy 2>&1 | tail -2
cd app && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E 'passed'
code_surfaces: src-tauri command registry + app/src/lib/ipc/* (scan-only; expected no change — notes used HTTP not IPC)
expected_tests: dependency-policy: allowlist no longer references removed tiptap/yjs packages and the gate passes
third-party-notices: regenerated notices pass check:third-party-notices with removed packages absent
package-lock audit test passes against the regenerated lockfile
app build + vitest green with the notes-only deps and dead api.ts functions removed
bundle-size delta recorded and shows reduction
implementation_notes: Precision over sweep: the ONLY packages removed are the 9 @tiptap/* and yjs. monaco-editor is shared with the code surfaces and STAYS — removing it would break CodeSymbolPanel/SourceControlPanel/code_intelligence. Do not 'clean up' any other dependency in this MT.

KEY IPC FINDING (grounding audit): the legacy notes editor did NOT use Tauri invoke for persistence — it called the backend over HTTP via app/src/lib/api.ts (request('/knowledge/documents...')). app/src/lib/ipc/* has no notes-document commands. So the 'dead IPC purge' is mostly an api.ts client-function purge, and the expected number of removed Tauri commands is ZERO. Prove it rather than removing speculatively.

Backend knowledge/loom routes are NOT dead: the native editors bind POST/GET/PUT /workspaces/{id}/knowledge/documents and the /loom/* endpoints (WP-KERNEL-012 MT-044 binds_backend_api). Removing them would break the native notes surface. They are explicitly out of scope / forbidden here.

Regenerate the lockfile via a clean, deterministic install so the diff is a real dependency-graph removal, not a hand-edited lockfile. The dependency-policy suite (allowlist.test.ts, bundled_library_policy.test.ts, third_party_notices.test.ts, package_lock_audit.test.ts) will fail until the removed packages are dropped from the allowlist and notices — update those fixtures as part of the purge.

Bundle-size evidence is the tree-shaking proof: if the dist size does not drop after removing tiptap+yjs, a dep is still reachable (a surviving import MT-262 missed) — treat a non-reduction as a RED finding, not a rounding artifact.
Portability: write bundle_size_delta.json under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT (default ../Handshake_Artifacts), never inside the repo; no hardcoded absolute paths.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Dependency/lockfile/dead-code purge with no operator-visible surface; evidence is the bundle-size delta artifact and the green dependency-policy/build gates. Final visual smoke of the native notes flow is MT-264.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: No operator-visible behavior change; the manual update declaring the native editor as the sole notes surface lands in MT-264 after the whole removal is proven.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: FlightRecorder: NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason — a build-graph/dependency purge emits no runtime events; the bundle-size delta artifact is the durable record.
internal_diagnostics: WIRED — the dependency-policy gate, third-party-notices check, and import-graph grep surface typed failures if a package is still reachable or the allowlist drifts.
Palmistry: NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason — no runtime posture change from removing build-time dependencies.
risk_if_missed: Leaving @tiptap/* and yjs in package.json lets a future contributor re-import the deleted editor (silently resurrecting the surface the operator removed), keeps the bundle bloated, and drifts the dependency-policy allowlist; over-removing monaco or a native-consumed backend route would instead break the code surfaces or the native notes editor.

risks: RISK-1: monaco-editor is removed as 'part of the editor', breaking the surviving code surfaces (CodeSymbolPanel, SourceControlPanel, code_intelligence) that depend on it.
RISK-2: A backend /knowledge or /loom route is deleted as 'dead notes IPC' while the native editors actively consume it, breaking the native notes surface.
RISK-3: A tiptap/yjs dependency is removed from package.json while a surviving file still imports it, so the build breaks (or worse, an allowlist stays stale and the gate lies).
RISK-4: An api.ts function still called by a surviving surface is removed, breaking a non-notes feature.
RISK-5: The lockfile is hand-edited instead of regenerated, leaving transitive tiptap/yjs packages resolved and the bundle unshrunk.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): monaco-editor is on the explicit KEEP list; a proof target asserts it remains in package.json and app/src/lib/monaco imports are intact; forbidden_paths bans touching app/src/lib/monaco.

CTRL-2 (RISK-2): Backend knowledge/loom route files are in forbidden_paths; route removal requires a usage scan proving zero native AND zero surviving-frontend consumers (expected: never satisfied for these routes).
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): Grep proof targets assert zero @tiptap/yjs source imports before removal and the regenerated lockfile is clean; the dependency-policy gate must pass with the updated allowlist.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): Each api.ts function is grep-verified for callers before removal; functions with a surviving caller are kept.

CTRL-5 (RISK-5): The lockfile is regenerated by a clean install and audited (package_lock_audit.test.ts); the bundle-size delta must show a real reduction, proving the packages actually left the graph.

research_provenance.source: Grounding audit 2026-07-21/22 of wtc-native-editors-v1 app/package.json (deps: @tiptap/* x9 all ^3.13.0, yjs ^13.6.27, monaco-editor ^0.55.1) and import graph: '@tiptap' Grep (59 source files, all in the MT-262 delete set), 'yjs' Grep (12 files: tiptap extension_set(+collab), build_editor_extensions, RichTextEditor, RichDocumentView + dependency_policy allowlist/tests), 'monaco' Grep (lib/monaco/* consumed by CodeSymbolPanel/SourceControlPanel/code_intelligence/breakpoint_gutter/language_registry — code surfaces that STAY). IPC finding: app/src/lib/ipc/* has no knowledge/notes-document invoke commands (Grep 'knowledge_document|invoke(' in lib/ipc returned only swarm/terminal/distillation); notes persistence is HTTP via app/src/lib/api.ts request('/knowledge/documents...') at lines ~749, 3192-3327. Backend routes bound by native per WP-KERNEL-012 MT-044 binds_backend_api. Dependency-policy tooling: app/package.json scripts check:dependency-policy, generate/check:third-party-notices, and app/src/lib/dependency_policy/ (runtime_dependency_allowlist.json + allowlist/bundled_library_policy/third_party_notices/package_lock_audit tests).
corrections: The 'dead Tauri IPC purge' framing is corrected by the codebase: notes used HTTP (/knowledge/documents via api.ts), not Tauri invoke — so the concrete purge target is dead api.ts client functions, and the expected count of removed Tauri commands and backend routes is zero.
monaco-editor is NOT a notes-only dependency despite MonacoCodeBlockView being deleted — it is shared with the code surfaces and stays; only @tiptap/* and yjs are notes-only.
Backend knowledge/loom routes are live (native-consumed) and are explicitly forbidden from removal here, distinguishing 'frontend client dead' from 'backend route dead'.
